name: zand-ce-hub
description: Persian-first learning hub powered by Go, htmx 4 and TypeScript 7

scripts.build:assets: npx --yes --package=typescript@7.0.2 tsc --noEmit false --target ES2022 --module ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir web/static --rootDir web/static/ts web/static/ts/app.ts
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run build:assets && go run ./cmd/export -out dist
